Name: Clint's Backstock
Author: rokugin
Description:
[u][size=5]Install[/size][/u]
[size=3]1. [url=https://smapi.io/]﻿Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]
2. Unzip the mod folder in the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]

[u][size=5]About[/size][/u]
[size=3]Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8918]Instant Tool Upgrades[/url] by Binarynova. <-- It's updated now, go check it out!
Removes the time needed to upgrade tools and changes a couple of dialogue lines that referenced the time.[/size]

[u][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/u]
[size=3]Works with the 1.6 PC version of Stardew Valley.
I don't have the game on anything else, so I can't currently say if it works anywhere else.
Works in multiplayer, everyone who wants to benefit from the mod has to have it installed.[/size]

[size=3][url=https://github.com/rokugin/ClintsBackstock]Source[/url][/size]
